response.evidence: All core and app unit tests, lintDebug, and assembleDebug pass cleanly following DeepSeek remediation. The camera barcode analyzer (`BarcodeCamera.kt`) and GTIN normalization correctly enforce format boundaries: EAN-8/13, UPC-A/E, 14-digit ITF, GS1-128 with AI (01), and numeric checksum-valid GTIN QR payloads are accepted and canonicalized, while marketplace identifiers (e.g., FNSKU X004QSH4ZH), non-GS1 linear formats (Code 39, Codabar, plain Code 128), short ITF, and non-numeric QR codes are rejected. Package migration verifier and device instrumentation confirm app identity (`net.jamesjennison.filamajignfc`), UI strings ('Filamajig NFC', 'Tap it. Tag it. Print it.', 'Filamajig NFC: Spool Tagger'), migrated user database integrity (2 custom records, 4 recents), and camera scanning on motorola razr 2023 without defects or regressions.
